Preserve every animation pose, exact scale and exact placement in its 512x512 cell; do NOT reposition or redraw the limbs, rotors, fire or body. No new expressions. Transparent background, same 4-column by 3-row atlas. Keep unused cells empty.
scope: 21 runtime sprite frames, original texture resources and animation timing unchanged
